meta.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
meta.description: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.
meta.slogan: A murder case of Madam D. with enormous wealth and the most outrageous events surrounding her sudden death!
